status: strategy specifications, not learned model capabilities
shared_rules: One user objective and evidence context

strategies.name: General reasoning
strategies.purpose: Analyze relationships, evidence, constraints and causes
strategies.activation_conditions: Material uncertainty or a decision requiring analysis
strategies.success_criteria: Verified task outcome improves versus the relevant control

strategies.name: Build and engineering
strategies.activation_conditions: Making, changing, training or maintaining a system
strategies.success_criteria: Whole agreed spec and integration challenge pass
limitations: A component pass is not project completion
strategies.generalization_boundaries: Software, AI and physical engineering need distinct actual tests

strategies.name: Visual imagination
strategies.activation_conditions: A design benefits from imagined layouts
procedure: Separate conceivable from physically feasible and verified
strategies.success_criteria: Useful feasible design validated by appropriate tests
limitations: A plausible image is not physical proof
strategies.generalization_boundaries: No visual ability is conferred on a model by these strategy records

strategies.name: Visual navigation
strategies.purpose: Interpret observed spatial state and safe transitions
strategies.activation_conditions: Existing scene, map or interface must be navigated
limitations: Never invent unseen obstacles or clear space
strategies.generalization_boundaries: Simulated, UI and physical navigation evaluated separately

strategies.name: Strategic navigation
strategies.purpose: Account for other agents and changing incentives
strategies.activation_conditions: Other actors materially affect the outcome
strategies.success_criteria: Improves safe outcomes in controlled evaluation

strategies.name: Creative ideation
strategies.activation_conditions: Existing approach stalls or alternatives are valuable
procedure: Hand candidates to engineering for tests
strategies.success_criteria: A validated candidate helps the objective

strategies.name: Creation Mode
strategies.purpose: Develop reusable strategies for verified gaps
strategies.activation_conditions: Existing strategies demonstrably do not fit the task
strategies.success_criteria: Fills a measured gap without regressions or permission expansion
limitations: No self-authorized tools, spending, safety exceptions or deployment
strategies.generalization_boundaries: Success on one task is not universal validity
